agenda_text:
CITY COUNCIL MEETING
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA CITY COUNCIL MEETING
October 23, 2018 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
INVOCATION: Pastor Richard Velasquez, Olive Branch Calvary Chapel
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE: VFW Post 9148
4.
ROLL CALL
5.
PUBLIC COMMENT
6.
APPEARANCES, PRESENTATIONS, AND PROCLAMATIONS
6.1
PRESENTATION TO THE CITY COUNCIL FROM ASSEMBLY MAJORITY LEADER IAN CALDERON - It is recommended the City Council receive a presentation by Assembly Majority Leader Ian Calderon.
6.1 Presentation by Assembly Majority Leader Ian Calderon
6.2
PROCLAMATION FOR RED RIBBON WEEK - It is recommended the City Council proclaim October 22 through October 26, 2018 as Red Ribbon Week in the City of La Mirada and present a proclamation to Safety Education Officer Mary Cipres.
6.2 Red Ribbon Week Proclamation
6.3
RECOGNITION OF PUBLIC SAFETY POSTER CONTEST WINNERS - It is recommended the City Council recognize the winners of the Public Safety Poster Contest and present them with Certificates of Recognition.
6.3 Public Safety Poster Contest
7.
APPOINTMENTS
7.1
APPOINTMENTS TO THE YOUTH COUNCIL - It is recommended the City Council reappoint Samuel Bentancourt, Yvonne Chen, Benjamin Coronado, Fabian Lee, Adriana Perez, Ariana Tirado, Sarah Usmani and Chloe Ward, and appoint Salem Haile to the La Mirada Youth Council for terms expiring in October 2019.
7.1 Appointments to Youth Council
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR
8.1
APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES - It is recommended the City Council approve the minutes of the Study Session meeting of October 9, 2018 and the minutes of the regular meeting of October 9, 2018.
8.1 Minutes of Oct. 9 Study Session
8.1 Minutes of Oct. 9 City Council Meeting
8.2
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER - It is recommended the City Council approve the warrant register dated October 23, 2018 in the total amount of $1,647,752.20.
8.2 Warrant Register
8.3
MONTHLY TREASURER REPORT FOR THE PERIOD ENDING SEPTEMBER 2018 – It is recommended the City Council receive and file the City of La Mirada Monthly Treasurer Report for the period ending September 2018.
8.3 Monthly Treasurer Report
8.4
INVESTMENT REPORT FOR THE CITY OF LA MIRADA FOR THE MONTH ENDING SEPTEMBER 2018 - It is recommended the City Council receive and file the City’s Investment Report for the month ending September 2018.
8.4 Investment Report
8.5
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2017-07, MEDIAN LANDSCAPE IMPROVEMENTS FOR LA MIRADA BOULEVARD FROM LEFFINGWELL ROAD TO ALONDRA BOULEVARD, AND CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2017-08, MEDIAN LANDSCAPE IMPROVEMENTS FOR ROSECRANS AVENUE FROM VALLEY VIEW AVENUE TO BEACH BOULEVARD – APPROVAL OF PLANS AND SPECIFICATIONS - It is recommended the City Council find that pursuant to the California Environmental Quality Act of 1970, the project is categorically exempt under Section 15101, Class (C) and will have no significant adverse effect on the environment; approve the plans and specifications for Capital Improvement Project No. 2017-07, Median Landscape Improvements for La Mirada Boulevard from Leffingwell Road to Alondra Boulevard, and Capital Improvement Project No. 2017-08, Median Landscape Improvements for Rosecrans Avenue from Valley View Avenue to Beach Boulevard; and authorize the City Clerk to advertise for sealed bids.
8.5 CIP Nos. 2017-07 and 2017-08
8.6
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2017-09, MEDIAN LANDSCAPE IMPROVEMENTS FOR VALLEY VIEW AVENUE FROM IMPERIAL HIGHWAY TO ROSECRANS AVENUE - APPROVAL OF PLANS AND SPECIFICATIONS - It is recommended the City Council find that pursuant to the California Environmental Quality Act of 1970, the project is categorically exempt under Section 15101, Class (C) and will have no significant adverse effect on the environment; approve the plans and specifications for Capital Improvement Project No. 2017-09, Median Landscape Improvements for Valley View Avenue from Imperial Highway to Rosecrans Avenue; and authorize the City Clerk to advertise for sealed bids.
8.6 CIP No. 2017-09
8.7
LA MIRADA SYMPHONY FUNDING REQUEST FOR FISCAL YEAR 2018-19 - It is recommended the City Council approve the La Mirada Symphony’s Fiscal Year 2018-19 funding request in the amount of $5,000 and an in-kind contribution of $40,000 for a total of $45,000.
8.7 La Mirada Symphony Funding Request
8.8
PURCHASE OF REPLACEMENT WIRELESS MICROPHONES FOR THE LA MIRADA THEATRE FOR THE PERFORMING ARTS - It is recommended the City Council approve the purchase of a new wireless microphone system in the amount of $54,526.45 from Apex Audio.
8.8 Purchase of Microphones for the Theatre
8.9
CITY COUNCIL REQUEST FOR CONFERENCE ATTENDANCE - It is recommended the City Council approve Councilmember Sarega’s attendance at the Whitehouse Conference with California Local Leaders.
8.9 City Council Request for Conference Attendance
9.
ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS
9.1
RESOLUTION NO. 18-28 AUTHORIZING AND APPROVING THE ADOPTION OF THE PENSION STABLIZATION TRUST AND APPOINTING THE CITY MANAGER AS THE CITY'S PLAN ADMINISTRATOR - It is recommended the City Council award the contract to Keenan Financial Services as the Pension Trust Program Administrator and Benefit Trust Company as the Discretionary Trustee with Morgan Stanley as the Registered Investment Advisor; direct the City Attorney to prepare an agreement with Keenan Financial Services for a term of three years with an option to renew for up to five additional one-year periods; adopt Resolution No. 18-28 authorizing and approving the adoption of the Pension Stabilization Trust and appointing the City Manager as the City's Plan Administrator; authorize the City Manager to sign the Pension Stabilization Trust for California Municipalities Participation Agreement with Benefit Trust Company; designate the City Manager as the City's representative to the Pension Stabilization Trust for California Municipalities Board of Authority; and authorize the initial deposit of $3.5 million to fund the trust with the Moderate Growth as the portfolio model of choice.
9.1 Resolution No. 18-28
